findings.title: User check skipped when Integration row doesn't exist yet
findings.body: When no Integration exists for the installation_id, the view calls pipeline.next_step() without comparing github_authenticated_user to the installer. An attacker who supplies a victim's installation_id before the installation webhook creates the Integration can bypass the new validation. The installation info and sender are then fetched in build_integration without any verification against the authenticated user.

findings.title: KeyError if integration metadata lacks sender
findings.body: The check reads integration.metadata["sender"]["login"] directly. Older integrations, and integrations created by build_integration when state has no sender, have no "sender" key. Reinstalling in those cases raises a 500 error instead of showing the error page. Use .get() and fail closed with error().

findings.title: OAuth redirect URL query not URL-encoded
findings.body: redirect_uri and the other parameters are inserted into the authorize URL by f-string, without urlencode. A redirect_uri with special characters, such as a query string or ports with paths, can be parsed incorrectly by GitHub. Build the query with urlencode.

findings.title: Network errors from token exchange are unhandled
findings.body: safe_urlopen sits outside the try block. A connection error or timeout reaching GitHub raises an unhandled exception and returns a 500 instead of the friendly error page. get_user_info is also called without error handling.
